description: From the Plaza del Cardenal Belluga, Murcia's baroque cathedral façade glows through the night haze — Jaime Bort's intricate front looking more like a sanctuary of statues than the outside of a church. The 93-meter tower, Spain's second tallest, rises beside it with the Episcopal Palace framing the square. On a foggy 20°C night the lights soften into halos, and the plaza's cafés keep their own quiet glow at the foot of three centuries of stone.
